mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_publish_variant (item_id, material_id, seller_sku, variant_text, variant_attrs_json, barcode, price, qty, cost, suggested_price, est_profit, est_margin, platform_sku_id, listing_id, sort, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{v.itemId}, #{v.materialId}, #{v.sellerSku}, #{v.variantText}, #{v.variantAttrsJson}, #{v.barcode}, #{v.price}, #{v.qty}, #{v.cost}, #{v.suggestedPrice}, #{v.estProfit}, #{v.estMargin}, #{v.platformSkuId}, #{v.listingId}, #{v.sort}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT v.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name FROM ecom_publish_variant v LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = v.material_id WHERE v.item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY v.item_id, v.sort, v.id
